$description: Rose color theme. Emitted under [data-color="rose"]. Every axis is the same shape: `600` for the resting action surface, `700` for hover, `500` for the focus ring, and white text. That is not a coincidence per hue — the ladder puts `600` at L 0.54, and white clears 4.5:1 below L 0.554 on every hue, so the foreground follows from the lightness rather than from a per-theme judgement.
